name: Neiafu
notes: Town, second largest in Tonga (pop 3,845, 2021) on the Port of Refuge harbour; open access, no single steward so no ticketUrl.

name: Mariners Cave
notes: Wikivoyage: day boat trips 'from several companies for about $50 per person' (island currency, TOP) visiting Mariners Cave, Swallows Cave and beaches; sold by many operators so no ticketUrl. Cave entered through an underwater tunnel (Wikivoyage).

name: Swallows Cave
notes: Wikivoyage: day boat trips 'from several companies for about $50 per person' (island currency, TOP) visiting Mariners Cave, Swallows Cave and beaches; sold by many operators so no ticketUrl. Described as excellent for snorkelling (Wikivoyage).

name: Hunga Island
notes: Wikivoyage: 35 min from Neiafu Harbour, main concentration of humpback whales, sheltered bays for cows with calves. Island has no entry fee; reached only on operator trips (many operators). Cost 50 TOP is the generic day-trip price quoted by Wikivoyage, not a Hunga-specific price: low confidence; alternative is free/open. No ticketUrl.

name: Pangaimotu
notes: Wikivoyage: second largest island in the group, joined by land bridge at the southern tip of 'Utu Vava'u, good beaches and snorkelling; Wikipedia: 5-minute boat trip from Neiafu. No fee in evidence; default open.

name: Mt Talau National Park
notes: Established 1995 (Wikivoyage); entrance ~2 km from Neiafu centre, trail ~1 km, steep 10-20 min climb to lookout. Tonga Pocket Guide lists it as a free activity; Lonely Planet reportedly conflicts (via search summary, unverified). No official agency site found. No parkPass applies (nt.gov.au is irrelevant to Tonga).

name: ʻEneʻio Botanical Garden
notes: Wikivoyage: Tu'anekivale village, east coast, tel +676 71 048, eneiobotanicalgarden@gmail.com, no price listed. Access is by guided tour: walk tours quoted T$35 (Lonely Planet, per search summary, unverified) to T$55 (Tonga Pocket Guide quotes NZ$110 on its own booking page, a third-party booker). LOW confidence price. No official site found (only an email); no ticketUrl; booker pages are aggregators, not recorded.
